chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Yusuf ibn al-Sukht, from Hamdan ibn al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Sayqal, who said:

Abu al-Hasan, meaning al-Rida (peace be upon him), came out to us on the twenty-fifth day of Dhi al-Qadah, and he said: 'Fast, for I have become a fasting person.' We said: 'May we be sacrificed for you, which day is it?' He said: 'It is a day in which Mercy was spread, the land was spread out, the Ka'bah was established, and Adam (peace be upon him) descended.'

key_terms.الرَّحْمَةُ: Mercy, referring to Divine Mercy being spread or manifested
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida, the title of the eighth Imam, Ali ibn Musa
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةُ: The Ka'bah, the sacred house in Mecca
key_terms.ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ: Dhi al-Qadah, the eleventh month of the Islamic lunar calendar

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of fasting on the 25th of Dhi al-Qadah according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) designated the twenty-fifth of Dhi al-Qadah as a day of voluntary fasting, linking it to the primordial event of Adam’s descent to earth. This narration highlights the day’s cosmic significance, associating it with the establishment of the Ka'bah and the manifestation of Divine Mercy, thereby elevating it as a key date in the Shia calendar for spiritual reflection and reward.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yusuf Bin Al Sukht, from Hamdan Bin Al Nazar, from Muhammad Bin Abdullah Al Sayqal who said,

‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, meaning Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> came out to us during the twenty fifth day of Zil-Qadah, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Fast, for I<sup>asws</sup> am Fasting’. We said, ‘May we be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! Which day is it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is a day in which the Mercy was Deployed, and the land was Spread during it, and the Kabah was established during it, and Adam<sup>as</sup> descended during it’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Yusuf al-Sukht from Hamdan ibn al-Nadr from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah al-Sayqal who has said the following:

“Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once came out to us on the twenty-fifth of the month of Dhul Qa’dah and said, ‘You should fast during this day. I am fasting.’ We then said, ‘We pray to Allah to keep our souls in service for your cause, which day is it?’ He replied, ‘It is the day during which the mercy (of Allah) was spread, the earth was extended and al-Ka‘bah was placed in place and Adam descended therein.’”
